The '''Danjar sector''' was in the [[Metharian Nebula Territories]] near [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. It seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] just before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] together with [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]] and [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], effectively blocking the Rimward leg of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] from Republic shipping.
